items.title: Classification of torsion groups of Q-curves over number fields of degrees three, five and seven
items.author: Ivan Novak
items.difficulty_reason: The complete small-odd-prime Q-curve classification transports Galois images through isogenies and systematically handles torsion exclusions in cubic fields and the cyclic-isogeny possibilities in quintic/septic fields. All three original degree statements and full group lists form one classification object. Old179110 only excludes cubicZ/15 via468–509; other torsion possibilities, structural isogeny arguments and degree5/7 proof obligations are additional retained content. Original CM cases are handled by the cited classification exactly as the author states, with subsequent non-CM scope preserved. Prime-degree corollaries/quadratic extension remain uncounted. Original auxiliary code cached locally without execution or computation certification.

primary.label: Original three degree-specific main theorems as one small-odd-prime torsion classification

proof_spans.label: Complete original isogeny/Galois-image structural support and all cubic/quintic/septic classification proofs
